title: Weekend Update- Jeanine Pirro on the Mexico–United States Border
text: And now, as a last special treat, here to give her parting thoughts tonight is Judge Jeanine Pirro. Judge Jeanine, I have not seen you in a while. Oh, I'm still here. My show on Fox is on every Saturday at 9, a full hour before the nursing homes turn off the TV in the lobby. But I did take some time off recently. I went down to the most luxurious place on Earth, Mar-a-Lago. Oh, it's like being on a cruise ship that's permanently docked in the hottest part of Florida in between two classy strip clubs, you know, where the gals wear ball gowns. There's an endless buffet of rubbery shrimp, and the air smells like a bathroom stall that's been freshly sprayed with poopery. That sounds wonderful, but you really don't have to be so loud. Oh, go ahead and judge me, Colin, but I'm proud to be a small-town girl who grew up... in an airport tarmac. I'm assuming you're not very happy with the job that President Biden is doing? He's a disaster! Have you seen the border? If Joe Biden had his way, we'd let everyone in, from gauchos to banditos, from chicas to chamacas, from El Chapo to Del Taco. I'm not sure that's true. Well, I am. And now they want to put Kamala Harris in charge of the border. Sorry, Kamala, I'm a ding-dong. Not on my watch. That seems a little racist. A little racist? Have you been listening to me? Colin, even as I watch our beautiful country get overrun by a gang of MS-13's angriest Mexican lesbians, I'm still standing strong, because I always did it my way. Hold that, Colin. Oh, for sure. That's a lot left. And now, the end is near. And so I face my friend. I'll say it clear. A great marquee of which I'm certain. Authentic. I've lived a life that's full. Bring in my other rhyme. I've traveled each and every highway. And more. Much more than this. I did it my way.
